rationale: The tight 1-minute consolidation beneath the $17.75 session high failed to break out, resolving instead into a sharp rejection candle that broke below the $17.68 micro-base on 38,302 shares—nearly five times the volume of the preceding bars. While the broader intraday trend remains too strong to justify flipping short, the sudden surge in selling volume at resistance invalidates the immediate breakout continuation thesis and warrants closing the position before the $17.54 stop is tested.
